coreIdea: OpenClaw is local-first: agents, tools and data stay on your own machine, and every capability is gated by an explicit policy.
explanation: ## What you get A local gateway, a Control UI, and agent runtimes you can drive from your chat channels. | Capability | Where it lives | |---|---| | Agents | `openclaw agents add ` | | Tools | policy-gated | Run `openclaw dashboard` to reopen the Control UI. The Gateway binds to `127.0.0.1:18789` by default, and nothing is exposed until you say so.
quote: 功能列表不是重点，重点是：什么留在本地、什么才被允许行动。
points: 一切从本地网关起步：默认只绑定 127.0.0.1，不主动对外暴露。
Control UI 与 CLI 是同一套能力的两个入口，`openclaw dashboard` 可随时打开。
工具调用受策略约束，`<plugin-spec>` 这类占位符要替换成真实插件名。
渠道（聊天软件）只是入口，真正的执行发生在你自己的机器上。
